name: Icon
purpose: One Material Symbols glyph widget for decorative chrome, status glyphs, chevrons, metadata glyphs, keycap glyphs, menu and command glyphs, and the tinted 32px glyph badge for sheets (tint axis; replaces A's IconBadge). Sizes are px with rem values; off-scale sizes snap to the nearest step with ties up (B): 13 to 14, 15 to 16, 19 to 20. Weight stays an axis (A: 200, 300, 400) because the measured 400 and 200 rows are visible; B's fixed 300 is not kept. Always pointer-events none, so a press reaches the parent control or drag region (B; replaces A's passThrough prop). Sources: A and B.
base: none (Material Symbols font, ligature names as in the catalogue; not a Radix primitive).

props.name: name
props.description: Material Symbols ligature name, for example drag_indicator, chevron_left, restart_alt. Required. For modifier keys the caller passes the platform glyph name.

props.name: label
props.description: Optional. Given, the icon has role img with this name. Omitted, it is decorative and aria-hidden. Required for the reduced-motion glyph. (Replaces A's decorative prop.)

states: expanded (rotate ccw90, driven by the caller)
error (caller swaps name to error; capture screenshot button)
role: img with a label when label is given (for example the reduced-motion status glyph). Otherwise none, aria-hidden.
keyboard: Never a tab stop. Inside a button, menu item or toggle, the parent holds focus and handles keys.
platform: Desktop only: window drag grip (desktop window chrome; web has no drag region), split-view markers (desktop split layout), capture clear, target and screenshot icons (capture bar; web has no screen capture), and settings capture pane icons. Keycap glyph: macOS desktop shows keyboard_command_key and keyboard_option_key; Windows and web show Ctrl and Alt as text, since the reference has no glyph name for either. Reduced-motion tooltip wording is per platform (see StatusIndicator). Sheets: desktop uses separate windows and web uses dialogs; the tinted badge is the same on both.
open: 1) Accent tone on the split-view marker (a state indicator; A) and the toast undo icon (follows the Undo button): accent is reserved for primary action and selection. B reads the split-view marker as a selection indicator and keeps accent. Decide the token and confirm. 2) Delete-confirm: the catalogue lists it under the accent sheet badge, but destructive actions use danger. Proposed: tint danger for delete-confirm. Confirm. 3) Weight conflict: A keeps 200, 300, 400 measured values; B folds everything to 300. Kept the axis. If the heavier stroke is not felt in review, collapse to 300 and drop the axis. 4) Colour not recorded for segment, settings tab, path folder, capture clear, capture target and capture screenshot: inherit assumed. Confirm in review. 5) Error glyph colour for the capture screenshot button is not recorded. 6) Reveal on focus-within for the attachment expand icon is an accessibility addition, not in the reference. 7) Split-view marker size 20 is assumed (no catalogue size). 8) Lightbox white at 70% folded to 60%. Confirm. 9) Sizes are in px in the reference; rem values are given here with 1rem = 14px.
